findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prices, write_option, post_bid, credit_markets, credit_open, hold_collect · Private data: markets, health, position, prices, open_short, close_short, supply, borrow, bind_builder, open_pair, close_pair, buy_with_eth, open_long, close_long, farms, farm_deposit, farm_withdraw, buy_cover, deposit_cover, withdraw_cover, claim_cover, write_option, post_bid, claim_option, release_collateral, credit_markets, credit_line, holder_benefits, credit_open, credit_pay, credit_gas, credit_bill, credit_bill_header, credit_repay, credit_guardrails, hold_open, hold_pay, hold_status, hold_collect · Public sink: position, supply, borrow, bind_builder, weekend, deposit_cover, settle_cover, claim_cover, options, write_option, buy_option, post_bid, settle_series, credit_line, holder_benefits, credit_open, credit_bill, credit_bill_header, hold_header, hold_collect, hold_end · Destructive: farms, farm_withdraw, withdraw_cover, holder_benefits, credit_bill_header.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prices, write_option, post_bid, credit_markets, credit_open, hold_collect · Private data: markets, health, position, prices, open_short, close_short, supply, borrow, bind_builder, open_pair, close_pair, buy_with_eth, open_long, close_long, farms, farm_deposit, farm_withdraw, buy_cover, deposit_cover, withdraw_cover, claim_cover, write_option, post_bid, claim_option, release_collateral, credit_markets, credit_line, holder_benefits, credit_open, credit_pay, credit_gas, credit_bill, credit_bill_header, credit_repay, credit_guardrails, hold_open, hold_pay, hold_status, hold_collect · Public sink: position, supply, borrow, bind_builder, weekend, deposit_cover, settle_cover, claim_cover, options, write_option, buy_option, post_bid, settle_series, credit_line, holder_benefits, credit_open, credit_bill, credit_bill_header, hold_header, hold_collect, hold_end · Destructive: farms, farm_withdraw, withdraw_cover, holder_benefits, credit_bill_header

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
